blocks.text: Numbers 25 contains 18 verses. It opens with: And Israel abode in Shittim; and the people began to play the harlot with the daughters of Moab: It concludes with: for they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.
